kafka.idempotence: same producer session; no blind application retry of ambiguous batches
kafka.durability_limit: Kafka replication ACK, no physical power-loss or all-disk-loss qualification

iceberg.publication: JDBC metadata pointer compare-and-swap; snapshot atomicity, not a cross-system transaction
iceberg.source_offsets: every committed row must exactly match an external acknowledged Kafka offset
iceberg.reader: Spark pinned snapshot plus independent PyIceberg/Arrow complete body oracle
iceberg.maintenance: native Spark rewrite_data_files while Flink appends
iceberg.retention: keep old snapshots/data for time travel; no destructive orphan expiry during live writes

seaweedfs.replication: 200: three copies in three simulated zones
seaweedfs.verification: direct native full-body reads from all three volume owners for current data files
seaweedfs.metadata: three-member etcd; two filers; one S3 gateway

failures.publication: hold catalog table metadata row, prove blocked UPDATE, kill its TaskManager, release row lock and restart
failures.maintenance: kill a native active Spark executor's owned worker during rewrite, then restart
failures.expected: source ACKs and pinned old reads continue; eventual exact snapshots without missing or duplicate acknowledged events

unsupported_claims: No catalog/JobManager/Spark-driver HA or independent disk/AZ durability
No update/delete/merge semantics or serializable multi-engine transaction
No physical power-loss durability or independent backup restore
No sustained-capacity winner from paced diagnostic phases
